(async () => {const down=document.querySelector('button[aria-label="Decrease temperature"]');for(let i=0;i<10;i++)down.click();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,60));const values=[];for(let t=16;t<=28;t++){const control=document.querySelector('button[aria-label="Increase temperature"]');const number=control.parentElement.parentElement.previousElementSibling;const n=number.getBoundingClientRect(),c=control.getBoundingClientRect();values.push({value:number.textContent,width:n.width,controlLeft:c.left});if(t<28){control.click();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,25));}}if(new Set(values.map(v=>v.width.toFixed(3))).size!==1||new Set(values.map(v=>v.controlLeft.toFixed(3))).size!==1)throw new Error(JSON.stringify(values));return {checked:values.length,width:values[0].width,controlsStable:true,tabularDigits:getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('button[aria-label="Increase temperature"]').parentElement.parentElement.previousElementSibling).fontVariantNumeric};})()
